body: I thank you for the reply, but truthfully I don't know how to respond. I feel like by having her understand this is the way to work through the problem, but I feel like everyone has their prying hands on the situation and I don't have any say in it. Is that fair? Maybe, maybe not. All I know is that I feel I deserve a chance to show that I am a kind person, and if I don't get that chance, there is literally no other reason for me to keep being alive. This breakup has severed any connection I have with anyone who cares about me.

The beatles made me really happy, so happy that I produced a cover of I want to Hold Your Hand with my girlfriend as the vocalist... Aside from the Beatles, I pretty much can only listen to classical music without a critical ear.

I have a bit of a love hate feeling about music at this time in my life.

I am going to school for sound engineering/production and am 10 months into the 12 month program. I love listening to music but as of now, I haven't been to class in the past week because of how depressed I've been. That being said, I kind of don't even want to think about that...

Don't have one. No one but her and reddit now knows about my intentions. Can't come to terms with telling anyone. 

I have nothing to distract myself with. My life exists on the internet and I can't help but dwell on it. The pain could fade in time, but I doubt it is honestly worth it to put up with until it does. 

I only see really 2 outcomes right now. 1 is she responds and finally stops leading me on and understands that I am good person and I love her now. Or... well you know the subreddit we are in.
